description: Full name field stored as text with 30 distinct non-null values, all unique. Contains diverse cultural naming conventions including Malay patronymics (Bin/Binte), Indian patronymics (s/o, d/o), and Chinese names. One value appears in lowercase ('lim wei jie') and one in all caps ('WANG SHI JIE'), deviating from the dominant Title Case format.
recommended_actions: [STANDARDIZE] Standardize case deviations to Title Case: 'lim wei jie' → 'Lim Wei Jie', 'WANG SHI JIE' → 'Wang Shi Jie'.
